caption: The drawing depicts a wooden plow composed of several pieces of roughly hewn wood, rendered in shades of brown and gray that highlight the grain and texture of the material. The structure consists of a long horizontal beam with an attached curved handle extending upward and to the right. There is a vertical wooden peg positioned near the middle of the beam, as well as a shorter protruding peg beside it. A curved metallic strip, shown in a muted gray, is fixed to the intersection where the handle meets the main beam, securing them together. Attached beneath the horizontal beam is a sharpened, reddish-brown blade or point, likely made of metal, which angles downward and outward, indicative of its use for plowing soil. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, providing no additional objects or scenery. The artist’s signature “Majel G. Claflin – Taos” appears in the bottom right corner.
title: Wooden Plow
